note: Phase 1 drawing test (2026-10-02). Read by tools/contact_sheet.py. Credits and licences are in ../research/play-image-plan.json.

drawings.name: Aeschylus · the Pythia (Eumenides)
drawings.alt: The Pythia, Apollo's priestess, fleeing in terror with her hands raised
drawings.source: Bötticher's 1859 drawing of an Apulian krater, Orestes at Delphi (Heidelberg scan, public domain)
drawings.method: Engraved plate: ink threshold, cut along her own lines, Apollo's overlapping foot erased, potrace

drawings.name: Sophocles · Oedipus (before the Sphinx)
drawings.alt: Oedipus, a young traveller in cloak and short tunic, standing with a spear
drawings.source: Achilles Painter pelike, Berlin F 2355, photograph by Gary Todd (CC0)
drawings.method: Red-figure photo: clay found by colour (shiny glaze), hair outlined by hand, potrace
drawings.verdict: Usable. The lower cloak is ragged where the vase is restored.

drawings.name: Euripides · Iphigenia (Iphigenia in Tauris)
drawings.alt: Iphigenia, priestess of Artemis, holding out a letter tablet and the temple key
drawings.source: 1849 lithograph of the Buckingham vase, Archäologische Zeitung Taf. XII (public domain)
drawings.method: Lithograph: hairlines found by local contrast, cut along her own lines, potrace
drawings.verdict: Clean. The tablet she shares with Pylades is cut at its middle.

drawings.name: Aristophanes · Mika (Women at the Thesmophoria)
drawings.alt: Mika, in a comic old woman's mask, holding out a bowl
drawings.source: Würzburg krater H 5697, photograph by ArchaiOptix (CC BY-SA 4.0)
drawings.method: Red-figure photo: clay mask, relief lines, Mnesilochus' knife cut away, potrace

drawings.name: Medea · in the serpent chariot
drawings.alt: Medea in a chariot drawn by two serpents
drawings.source: Cleveland Museum of Art 1991.1, museum photograph (CC0)
drawings.method: Red-figure photo: clay mask, disk border cut away, sleeve outlined by hand, potrace
drawings.verdict: Usable; busier than the others (speckle in the serpents' spots).

drawings.name: Iphigenia at Aulis · FAILED (not for use)
drawings.alt: Failed test: hand outline of the letter scene on the Met relief bowl
drawings.method: Worn low relief: automatic tracing found no lines; hand outline only
drawings.verdict: Failed. Needs a draughtsman, or better raking-light photographs.
